readme.markdown:
Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

**Opinionated** — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work **Extensible** — override or replace any piece without forking **Model-agnostic** — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local **Production-ready** — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith
